canonical.title: Weekend in Jongieux around a Saturday dinner at Les Morainières

sources.title: Les Morainières — official site
sources.claim: Restaurant home, +33 4 79 44 03 20.

sources.title: Les Morainières — situation et accès
sources.claim: 1400 route de Marestel, 73170 Jongieux; Chambéry 25 km.

sources.title: La Maison des Morainières
sources.claim: 6 plant-named rooms at 68 route du Grand Bois, Saint-Pierre-de-Curtille; free shuttle to restaurant for lunch and dinner.

sources.title: Séjour Découverte package
sources.claim: €880 for two: two Découverte menus, wine pairings, champagne, one night, two breakfasts.

sources.title: Les Morainières — three stars 2026
sources.claim: Three Michelin stars in March 2026 Guide MICHELIN France & Monaco.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Les Morainières
sources.claim: Michelin Guide listing; chef's guesthouse a few kilometres away.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Les Morainières
sources.claim: Tasting menu ~€240; service Thu–Sun 12:15–12:30 lunch, 19:30–20:00 dinner.

sources.title: Château de la Mar
sources.claim: 17th-c. château with spa, gîte, 6 ha HV3 Marestel vineyard, La Table 1625.

sources.title: La Table 1625
sources.claim: Château de la Mar's bistronomic restaurant, in collaboration with Michaël Arnoult; €35 menus, Mon–Fri.

sources.title: Domaine Carrel & Senger
sources.claim: Working winery since 1830; 4 guest rooms above the chai, 1.42 km / 19 min walk to the restaurant.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Carrel & Senger
sources.claim: 4.9/5 over 36 reviews.

sources.title: Les Chambres du Cru — Edmond Jacquin
sources.claim: 3 rooms (Pinot, Mondeuse, Gamay); from €80/night for two; breakfast included.

sources.title: Gîtes de France — Chambres du Cru
sources.claim: €80 / night; rated 'Très bien' 4.34/5; owners Arlette & Patrice Jacquin.

sources.title: Domaine Edmond Jacquin & Fils
sources.claim: 6th-generation domaine, Mon–Sat 9–12 & 14–18; Jacquère, Altesse, Mondeuse, Gamay, Pinot Noir, Crémant.

sources.title: Domaine Dupasquier
sources.claim: 15-ha family vineyard in Aimavigne; 3-hour visit-tasting-snack package €26 by reservation.

sources.title: Cru Jongieux
sources.claim: Largest Vin de Savoie cru — 250 ha terraced by hand from 1990, south-west slopes of Mont du Chat.

sources.title: Cru Marestel — Vin de Savoie
sources.claim: Marestel AOC since 1973: Roussette de Savoie from Altesse; smoky, floral, almond notes.

sources.title: Festival du Cru Jongieux 2026
sources.claim: 3rd edition, 18–19 July 2026; 2 km gourmet walk, food pairings by Arnoult; €80 until 30 June, €90 after.

sources.title: Bateaucanal — cruises from Chanaz
sources.claim: Daily cruises 4 Apr–25 Oct 2026: Savoyard, Savoyard 2 and electro-solar Solely.

sources.title: Bateaucanal — Grand Tour
sources.claim: 2h15 cruise: Canal de Savières + Lac du Bourget + canalised Rhône with lock; €18.50 adult online.

sources.title: Moulin de Chanaz
sources.claim: Historic-Monument-listed walnut-oil mill, stone-millstone pressing since 1868.

sources.title: Chanaz — Petite Cité de Caractère
sources.claim: Officially labelled Petite Cité de Caractère; 'petite Venise savoyarde'.

sources.title: Chanaz — town site
sources.claim: Gallo-Roman museum (Portout potters), craftsmen, mill and restaurants.

sources.title: Abbaye d'Hautecombe
sources.claim: Wed–Sun 10:00–11:15 and 14:30–17:00; Royal Apartments tour €7.50; Mass daily except Tue at noon.

sources.title: Lac du Bourget cruises — tourist office
sources.claim: 100% electric boats from Le Grand Port; Heritage cruise to Hautecombe; from €18 adult.

sources.title: Compagnie des Bateaux — Découverte 1h15
sources.claim: 1h15 Découverte loop from Grand Port reception pavilion.

sources.title: La Chambotte belvedere
sources.claim: Rooftop terrace 360° over the full Lac du Bourget and Hautecombe; free, year-round.

sources.title: Thermes Chevalley 2026 season
sources.claim: Aix-les-Bains thermal spa open to public 24 Jan 2026 – 3 Jan 2027.

sources.title: Thermes Chevalley — Aqua-détente
sources.claim: Daily 10:00–19:00; €25 weekdays / €27 weekends.

sources.title: Musée Faure — closed for 2026
sources.claim: Closed throughout 2026; reopens early 2027 as 'La Villa – Collection d'art'.

sources.title: Mont Granier hike
sources.claim: 12 km / +1,100 m / 6 h; cabled Pas des Barres; open 1 May – 30 Nov only.

sources.title: Boucle autour de Jongieux
sources.claim: 10.6 km waymarked loop, 337 m gain, ~4 h, moderate; starts at Jongieux church.

sources.title: Yenne — Notre-Dame-de-l'Assomption
sources.claim: 12th–15th c., Historic Monument since 1987; historiated capitals and Gothic stalls.

sources.title: Logis Le Fer à Cheval — open Apr–Oct only
sources.claim: Open 7 days a week 1 April – 30 October; closed in winter.

sources.title: Musée Savoisien
sources.claim: Reopened after 8-year renovation in a 13th-c. Franciscan convent; free entry.

sources.title: Fontaine des Éléphants
sources.claim: Built 1838 in tribute to General de Boigne; 17.65 m; cross-of-Savoy plan.

sources.title: Les Charmettes — Rousseau's house
sources.claim: Tue–Sun 10–18, 1 Apr – 31 Oct; weekends only in winter; gardens free year-round.

sources.title: USMB cybersecurity lecture
sources.claim: Tue 21 April 2026, 18:00–19:30, free, 27 rue Marcoz, Chambéry.

sources.title: SOPHIA PV Reliability Workshop
sources.claim: 23–24 April 2026, INES CEA Bourget-du-Lac — registrations closed.

sources.title: DevFest Lyon 2026
sources.claim: 4 December 2026 — closest major dev conference, ~85 km away.

sources.title: Le Doux Nid — Chanaz
sources.claim: 18th-c. coaching inn on Canal de Savières, themed rooms, boat rental.

sources.title: Jongieux → Chanaz distance
sources.claim: 9.9 km, ~12 min by car.

sources.title: Aix-les-Bains → Jongieux distance
sources.claim: 24 km road.

sources.title: Chambéry → Jongieux distance
sources.claim: 25.2 km, ~27 min via Route du Tunnel and D210.
